job.title: National Account Executive | Premium Food | Sydney
job.description:
The Business  
This is an exciting opportunity to join the Australian arm of an established international FMCG business with a strong reputation for quality and a growing presence in the local market. The business has experienced significant growth in Australia and continues to invest in its people, customer partnerships and commercial strategy. Operating within a lean, high-performing team, this is an opportunity to make a genuine impact, work closely with key retail customers and contribute to the next phase of the business’s growth.
 
The Role The National Account Executive sits at the operational heart of the commercial team. You will be the person who makes sure promotional programmes land correctly, forecasts are accurate, and deadlines are met across Woolworths, Coles, Metcash and key independents. When this role is done well, the Senior National Account Managers can focus entirely on growing the business.

Key areas of responsibility include:
  • Promotional Management — End-to-end ownership of promotional programmes across major grocery retailers. Submitting plans, managing retailer portals (including Woolworths Partner Hub and Coles PAFs), tracking confirmations, and ensuring flawless execution within tight deadlines.
  • Commercial Analysis & Forecasting — Day-to-day sales analysis and performance reporting, supporting S&OP and forecasting cycles in close collaboration with the category team. Your accuracy with data will directly shape the team's ability to plan and execute with confidence.
  • Claims & Trade Spend Management — Managing claims reconciliation across major retail customers and liaising with the international back-office team to ensure trade investment is accurately tracked and processed.
  • Sales Support — Supporting range reviews, new line set-up, customer presentation development, and ad hoc administrative tasks across grocery, foodservice and independent channels.
The Candidate
You don't need to have done this exact role before — but you do need to bring the right mindset: detail-oriented, analytically driven, proactive, and hungry to learn.

You might currently be working in a field sales or key account role within FMCG, or in an analytical capacity at a data agency. What matters most is your attitude and your application.

You will bring:
  • Experience in a sales, account management or analytical role within FMCG or a related field
  • Strong attention to detail and genuine pride in the accuracy of your work
  • Analytical capability, and a desire to continue developing in this area
  • The ability to manage multiple competing priorities without dropping the ball
  • Confidence communicating with senior stakeholders — knowing when to ask, when to escalate, and how to do both well
  • A team-first attitude and the energy to thrive in a small, fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with IRI, Nielsen or Quantium data tools is advantageous but not essential
Why This Role
This is not just an admin role with a fancy title. It is a genuine commercial position within a business that punches well above its weight. In a team this size, your contribution is visible, your development is real, and your impact is immediate.

If you want to learn the commercial mechanics of FMCG from the inside — this is the role to do it in.

Click apply to be considered today and forward any questions to Dan Edwards on dan@axr.com.au

job.title: Assistant Brand Manager
job.description:

Our flagship brand was created in Australia, leads its category here and is now exported internationally. With a lean marketing team and an ambitious growth agenda, we offer real breadth for someone who wants hands-on exposure across the full marketing mix.

Supporting delivery of the annual brand plan, you'll take real ownership of the brand's social, influencer and campaign activity, executing digital work that drives growth, relevance and consumer connection.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Lead day-to-day social media across Meta and TikTok – content planning, publishing, community management and performance optimisation – and own reporting and insights against KPIs
  • Manage the influencer program, from briefing, content development and approvals through to posting schedules and performance tracking
  • Develop and deliver digital, social and content-led campaigns behind new product launches, and identify and manage brand collaborations
  • Execute the consumer sampling program and support above-the-line communications, working closely with internal stakeholders and agency partners
  • Track and report brand A&P and digital budgets 
  • Manage the global asset download centre and partner on international digital initiatives
What You'll Bring:
  • A degree in Marketing or Business, plus 5+ years' marketing experience
  • A strong focus on digital, social and influencer marketing, with confidence across Meta and TikTok
  • An independent, autonomous self-starter with initiative and a positive, can-do attitude – you see what needs doing and get on with it
  • Strong attention to detail, excellent time management and a proven ability to deliver on time and to target
  • Curiosity and a real hunger to learn and develop across the full marketing mix
  • An energetic, relationship-driven approach that thrives in a small, close-knit team; FMCG, beverage or food service experience is a plus
Why Join?
This is a chance to take real ownership of the digital agenda for a homegrown brand with global reach, new launches to bring to market and international markets to partner on. With a strong possibility of permanency and a path towards Brand Manager within 12–24 months, it's an ideal next step for an ambitious, digitally minded marketer.

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
The Company:

Our client is the Australian operation of a multi-billion-dollar global business that operates in dozens of international markets. It’s owned by a private equity firm with a long-term hold strategy. The group works across both B2B and B2C markets, and its purpose centres on product quality and environmental sustainability. Its decentralised model gives local teams the freedom to tailor solutions and service to the markets they know best. This role sits within a B2B-focused business unit where marketing is central: it shapes the entire customer experience and plays a key role in strategy and performance. This is a confidential search, and the employer’s identity will be shared with shortlisted candidates once they have signed a Non-Disclosure Agreement.

The Role:

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, the Marketing Manager will drive lead generation, conversion, marketing ROI and brand growth for the Australian business. Your focus will be split roughly 65% on lead generation and demand creation and 35% on brand. You’ll turn marketing strategy into measurable commercial outcomes across paid media, website, digital, CRM and customer lifecycle campaigns, and keep brand positioning consistent at every customer touchpoint.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Develop and run B2B campaigns that drive qualified leads, including ABM and lifecycle programmes that make the most of existing accounts
  • Manage and optimise paid media, SEO, SEM, marketing automation, retargeting and conversion programmes to maximise ROI and customer acquisition
  • Support the development and delivery of brand strategy, building awareness, consideration and brand equity across the portfolio
  • Work with the CRM team to use Salesforce data to improve engagement, retention, upsell, cross-sell and recurring revenue
  • Own website performance, user experience, landing pages and lead capture, and report on KPIs with actionable insights
  • Manage agency and media partners, work with Sales, Customer Experience and the global marketing centre of excellence, and build a small team, starting with a digital specialist and a brand specialist
What You’ll Bring:
  • At least five years’ experience across digital, performance and brand marketing, with a strong track record in lead generation, acquisition, conversion optimisation and marketing ROI
  • Hands-on skills across paid media, Google Ads, SEO, marketing automation, CRM and website optimisation, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves at the start
  • Experience developing brand campaigns that build awareness and support commercial outcomes, balancing short-term performance with long-term brand growth
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn customer and marketing data into decisions and action
  • Experience managing marketing budgets, creative agencies and media partners, along with strong stakeholder influencing and communication skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced, mid-sized business. A background in B2B, service, subscription or aftermarket revenue models, and experience with Salesforce and lifecycle marketing, will be highly regarded

Why Join?

Report directly to the Managing Director in a business investing in hypergrowth. You’ll build your own team, help shape the move to a more consumer-led marketing model, and have scope to grow into a Senior Marketing Manager role and potentially join the Senior Leadership Team. The package includes a competitive base salary plus a performance-linked bonus. The role is hybrid, with three days a week in the Western Sydney office, on-site parking and an easy walk from the train station.

The portfolio leads its categories, with deep consumer trust, strong healthcare-professional endorsement and real scale across pharmacy and grocery. Our marketing team is flatter and low-ego, and it's building new skills in content, social and the smart use of AI.

The Role:
This Senior Brand Manager role owns the flagship brand portfolio, a $130m+ business and the engine of the company. You'll report to a senior Marketing Manager and have full commercial accountability for a market leader that new challenger brands are taking on. The brief is to defend and grow its position, reconnect it with the next generation of consumers and lead a significant innovation pipeline.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Own the P&L and a sizeable A&P budget, including forecasting, pricing, S&OP and monthly reconciliation to plan
  • Develop and deliver the annual brand plan while building on the three-year strategy, and get cross-functional teams aligned behind it
  • Shape the future portfolio: brand architecture, sub-ranges, SKU rationalisation and an innovation pipeline of 12+ launches
  • Lead integrated consumer and trade communications, including digital, social and PR, with external agency partners
  • Partner with senior Sales and National Account Managers across pharmacy, grocery and e-commerce, including range reviews
  • Coach and develop the Assistant Brand Managers in the brand team, and support healthcare-professional engagement
What You'll Bring:
  • Seasoned Senior Brand Manager experience, ideally in FMCG within health, wellness or pharmacy, with a strong track record of owning a brand end to end
  • Full A-to-Z brand management skills, where brand planning, forecasting, pricing, NPD, rationalisation and deletions are second nature
